OffPDF v0.3.2 expands the offline desktop editor and improves everyday file handling.

Highlights:

- Secure redaction rasterizes only affected pages and verifies that covered source content is absent before publishing.
- Supported files can be opened with OffPDF directly from Finder, Explorer, and Linux desktops.
- OCR discovers locally installed Tesseract packs and supports multiple document languages.
- The home screen now includes keyboard-first tool search.
- Edit PDF gains broader annotation, form, validation, and interaction coverage.

Known issue:

- Some real-device HEIC/HEIF files may still crash on Windows; investigation continues in issue #14.

Thanks to @nonamexishere, @lKolabrodl, and @terminalchai for contributing to this release.

Packages:

- Signed and notarized DMG for Apple Silicon Macs
- Windows x64 NSIS installer — unsigned while Authenticode signing is pending. Verify the accompanying SHA-256 file before use.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/McanKul/offpdf/blob/v0.3.2/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.
